snippet.title: Tidy Up Together - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. 

It's time to Tidy Up!

Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your Adventurer's shop. All 4,000+ of your fantasy-themed products are all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

The Steam Page is now live. The game will be out very soon - Wishlist Now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4950470/Tidy_Up_Together/

#cozygames #steamgame
